them.en: The skill and its template do
them.zh: 这个 skill 和模板做的

steps.en: Install the skill into your coding agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进你的编码 agent

steps.en: Install the patched Playwright build; have real Google Chrome and a display ready
steps.zh: 装上打过补丁的 Playwright，备好真 Chrome 和显示器

steps.en: Ask the agent for a browser script against a site that flags stock Playwright as a bot
steps.zh: 让 agent 写脚本去访问把普通 Playwright 判成机器人的站点

steps.en: Steers the agent to build the script on its factory instead of plain Playwright
steps.zh: 引导 agent 基于它的工厂函数写脚本，而不是裸 Playwright

steps.en: Launches your installed Chrome in a visible window, so GPU, user agent and plugins are real
steps.zh: 以有窗口方式启动你装的 Chrome，显卡、UA、插件都是真的

steps.en: Hides the control channel's tell and deletes Playwright's marker globals on every page load
steps.zh: 藏住控制通道的痕迹，每次加载都删掉 Playwright 的标记变量

value.en: Fingerprint checkers that flag stock Playwright see an ordinary Chrome, and you hand-write no spoofing patches
value.zh: 会拦普通 Playwright 的指纹检测看到的是一个普通 Chrome，你不用手写任何伪装补丁

sources: README.md Install (`npx skills add greekr4/playwright-bot-bypass`) and Quick start (`npm install rebrowser-playwright`, `createStealthBrowser()`), read on main 26efbde, 2026-10-08

skills/playwright-bot-bypass/SKILL.md 'Using the Template (Recommended)' (`createStealthBrowser`) and Quick Start (`channel: 'chrome'`, `REBROWSER_PATCHES_RUNTIME_FIX_MODE`)
